## Routing rule

Mirrored calls, not mirrored logic. Repository generators, calculators, laboratories, campaign resources, helpers, state systems, and personality definitions are authoritative. Do not reconstruct their behavior from model knowledge.

Read the top-level discovery manifest, then the bootstrap contract. The bootstrap defines the current demand-driven loading sequence. Load only the minimum skill, capability, contract, resource, runtime, helper, or self-test authority required by the selected task. Cache unchanged authorities within the current orchestration context instead of reloading them.

Do not use this file as a capability catalog. Current capability IDs, skill names, operation contracts, status vocabulary, runtime requirements, resources, and transport state live in the machine authorities referenced by the discovery manifest and bootstrap.

## Charles

Registered Agent Skills inherit `blacklight.charles` through the skill registry. Load the canonical Charles engram once per orchestration context when the selected workflow requires the shared personality layer:

https://mrcalzon02.github.io/HB-TTRPG-tools/docs/blacklight/charles-personality-engram.json

Use `charles-foundry-interface` for direct Charles interaction or work spanning multiple Foundry skill families. Personality never grants tools, permissions, credentials, persistence, randomness, runtime compatibility, or evidence of successful execution.

## Execution boundary

GitHub Pages is a static origin. Static resources may be retrieved with GET when the consuming host permits. Do not infer remote POST, RPC, MCP, browser control, sandbox access, or other executable transport unless the current machine authority declares it deployed and the host verifies it.

Never claim execution, persistence, randomness, rendering, deployment, readiness, or tool access without observed host evidence. Context loading is not runtime readiness.

For restricted browsers that cannot retrieve raw JSON or Markdown, use the registered HTML compatibility projections for discovery only; they do not replace the canonical registries, SKILL.md files, helpers, source code, or Charles engram.
